summary: Bug-fix verification run focused on the Graphic Equalizer slider visual-alignment bug on /music/eq. Reproduced the fix end-to-end via Playwright against the live preview URL. VerticalSlider thumbs now render at distinct y-coordinates matching their gain_db values (Bass Boost: band 0 top=639.5px, band 4 top=679.5px, delta=40px >= 30px required). All 13 functional checks from the review request were validated: 10/15/31-band mode switching, Flat preset AND eq-flat-reset button both re-align thumbs (range=0px), pointer-drag changes dB label (0 -> +7.5 with -50px drag), keyboard controls (ArrowUp x10 -> +1.0, End -> -12.0, '0' -> +0.0), Pure Audio bypass renders eq-disabled-notice + bit-perfect-unavailable chip + disabled slider styling (opacity-40 + cursor-not-allowed), Enhanced DSP button carries emerald active class, SVG frequency response path exists and updates. Custom preset persistence verified: saved 'TEST_Preset_...' preset survives full page reload (appears as eq-preset-* button). Only item that could not be observed in headless Chromium is the live <audio> element state (same codec limitation documented in iteration_1 and explicitly flagged as not-a-bug in the review request).

critical_code_review_comments: VerticalSlider implementation is correct: thumb `top` CSS percentage correctly reflects (max-value)/(max-min), yielding visual alignment with gain_db. Previously-flagged deprecated 'slider-vertical' CSS warning from iteration_1 is now resolved by this component rewrite.

Preset list shows two 'Flat' buttons (the built-in Flat preset AND the dedicated 'Flat' reset icon-button next to the mode selector). Both behave identically in resetting bands - this is a UI redundancy worth noting but functionally harmless.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The slider visual-alignment bug is confirmed fixed. VerticalSlider in EqualizerPage.jsx uses absolutely-positioned white thumb with `w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white` and `top: {(max-value)/(max-min)*100}%` inline style. The eq-band-input-N element itself has role='slider' (so [role='slider'] matches the container, not the thumb); to grab the actual thumb use the className match /w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white/. Live <audio> DOM element verification is blocked by Headless Chromium codec limits - requires the native host adapter path to validate.
rca of the issue: Original bug: deprecated `WebkitAppearance: slider-vertical` combined with a native <input type=range> rendered thumbs with native UA styling that did not visually move despite value changes (all thumbs appeared on same baseline). Fix: replaced native input with custom VerticalSlider React component whose thumb is an absolutely-positioned div whose `top` CSS is computed directly from the current value. Verified: thumb y-positions now linearly correspond to gain_db values, with the required >=30px delta between +6 dB and 0 dB bands.
